purpose: Current product requirements and configured Premium offer. Entitlements are granted only by verified server-side Stripe events.
supersedes: Previous catalogue, templates, individual upgrades, rewards, roulette and clock-sale proposals
priority: Give readable note previews the largest practical share of the screen
Keep writing immediate and drawing tools inside the note
Validate local persistence, access controls, cloud boundaries and responsive layouts
Provide an Android app with local data and resources, using the server for account and cloud functions

notes.free_note_access_policy: During the first 30 days after account registration, the account may create and read any number of notes. After the trial, positions 1-6 remain readable for free. Positions 7 and above are locked for a further 30 days, show a localized Premium notice and deletion countdown, then are permanently deleted unless Premium is active.
notes.existing_accounts_rollout: Give current accounts 30 days from activation before locking notes beyond position 6.
notes.premium_limit_reason: Premium removes the post-trial lock and keeps existing extra notes readable; new-note creation retains the current 100-note Premium ceiling.
notes.shape: Approximately square sticky notes with readable text previews
notes.navigation: Swipe between pages on touch screens; previous and next controls plus current page indicator
notes.drawing: Available inside the same note, without a separate purchase
notes.existing_data: Preserve existing notes and purchased rights. Never delete notes merely because the commercial offer changes.
notes.access_enforcement: Server-authoritative for cloud data; device-local for guest notes
notes.size_policy: 10 decimal MB including text, drawings, metadata and stored attachments. Delete existing notes above this limit and reject every oversized mutation. User explicitly authorized this policy on 2026-10-11.

Apply the Premium billing database migration
Deploy the updated Edge Function and website
Validate recurring renewals, failed invoices, cancellation, lifetime purchases and account isolation
